question: Should Signal quote suppression and native quote delivery be exposed through this PR's public `replyToId: null` SDK contract, or should the work move to the maintainer native Signal quote path with a narrower/private suppression seam?
rationale: The correct API boundary and canonical Signal quote branch are maintainer product/API choices; automation can identify the conflict but cannot safely decide the long-term plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Use the maintainer native quote path
options.body: Prefer the maintainer-sponsored Signal quote implementation as the canonical direction, then close or narrow this branch after its unique useful tests or fixes are ported.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing branch only after it fixes BodyForAgent quote context, removes or documents the public null SDK contract, and adds live Signal proof.

options.title: Accept the public null contract
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally bless `replyToId: null` as plugin API, but that should come with docs, baseline/API tests, and compatibility messaging.

recommendation.title: Use the maintainer native quote path
recommendation.body: Prefer the maintainer-sponsored Signal quote implementation as the canonical direction, then close or narrow this branch after its unique useful tests or fixes are ported.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping maintainer-labeled native Signal quote PR already carries the clearest owner signal for this product/API choice.
